# 5. Modern UI aesthetics and design tokens

Implement these in `resources/css/keystone.css` (and Blade structure), **not** as a new slate/dark Tailwind skin. Tokens stay charcoal + stone + forest (`--ink`, `--paper`, `--line`, `--accent`, `--radius`, `--shadow`). Do not introduce `dark:` slate palettes or SaaS-blue defaults.

## A. Layout and spacing

**5.1 Fluid containers.** Main content width is capped and centered.

- Target: `max-width: 80rem` (`1280px`, Tailwind `max-w-7xl`). Today `.wrap` is `--maxw: 1200px` — when you change layout, move `--maxw` to `80rem` rather than sprinkling `max-w-7xl` on every section.
- Horizontal padding: equivalent of `px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8` (16px / 24px / 32px). Keep it on `.wrap` / `.hero-inner` so pages stay aligned.
- Center with `margin-inline: auto`.

**5.2 Bento and cards.** Default card chrome (intent cards, listing cards, agent cards, search panels, Pulse, tour steps, reviews):

- Fill: `--card-bg` (`#fff`). Do **not** use `--white` for card faces — it is warm cream and disappears into `--paper`.
- Border: `1px solid` `--line`. No forest/ink top bar, left bar, or hover outline in `--accent`.
- Radius: `--radius` ≈ `1rem`+ (`rounded-2xl` / 16–18px).
- Shadow: `--shadow-rest` at rest, `--shadow-lg` on hover (~200ms). Thin elevation, not a color frame.
- Forest stays on kickers, stars, links, and `:focus-visible` — never on the card chrome.

`resources/css/card-lock.css` is imported **last** in `app.css`. Do not delete it, do not move it above `keystone.css`, and do not “restore” `.step::before` to a tiny forest kicker. Tour step numbers stay large, bold, and `--ink-faint`.

Reuse existing classes (`.intent-card`, `.step`, `.market-stat`, `.review-card`, listing minis) instead of a one-off utility stack.

Do not merge stale homepage PRs that rewrite all of `keystone.css` from an older `main` (#18–#22, #25). Rebase those onto current `main` or close them.

**5.3 Typography scale.** Modular, tracking tight on headings. Prefer CSS on `h1`/`h2`/`.lede` over repeating Tailwind on every heading.

| Role | Scale (approx) |
| --- | --- |
| H1 | `clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.75rem)` — `text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl`, `font-semibold`, `tracking-tight` |
| H2 | `clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 1.875rem)` — `text-2xl sm:text-3xl`, `font-semibold`, `tracking-tight` |
| Body | `1rem` / `1.125rem` large screens, `line-height: 1.65`, color `--ink-soft` — not `text-slate-600` |

Homepage cinematic H1 may stay larger (hero already uses `clamp` ~2.5–4.6rem). Marketing `page-hero` H1 should stay readable, not tiny.

Fonts stay Customizer-driven (default Inter).

## B. Image overlay and polish

**5.4 Hero text contrast.** Type on photography **must** sit on a protective gradient so contrast holds on a bright or dark photo (WCAG).

Existing pattern: `.hero-veil` over `.hero-media`, copy in `.hero-inner` (`z-index` above the veil). Do not put white text directly on the `<img>`.

Equivalent structure:

```html
<div class="relative overflow-hidden">
  <img … class="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" />
  <div class="absolute inset-0" aria-hidden="true"><!-- ink/forest gradient, not slate-950 --></div>
  <div class="relative z-10 text-white">…</div>
</div>
```

Keystone veil (keep this direction):

```css
linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(12,12,12,.82) 0%, rgba(12,12,12,.45) 46%, rgba(12,12,12,.25) 100%),
linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(12,12,12,.7) 0%, transparent 45%);
```

LCP hero photos use `partials/hero-image.blade.php` (`fetchpriority="high"`, `loading="eager"`, `srcset`, `1600×900`).

Focus rings, 44px targets, and reduced motion: see `accessibility.mdc` (6.3–6.6).

## Do not

- Restyle the site with `slate-*` / `dark:bg-slate-900` utility dumps
- Drop the concept demo banner or forest accent
- Put hero H1 on the photo with no veil
